title: A weak absorber (α = 10 cm⁻¹, 1 µm) in n = 1.5 under an aplanatic NA 0.23–0.5 cone: the path factor

series.label: ⟨1 / cos θ⟩ of the aplanatic cone, 1.0357

note: A focused beam crosses a film obliquely, so a weak absorber looks thicker by the cone's mean path factor ⟨1 / cos θ⟩, 1.0357 for an aplanatic NA 0.23–0.5 pupil in n = 1.5, the ruling the test pins. The test also checks that an empty stack, or a sample that is its own reference, has zero absorbance and that Köhler illumination equals coherent for a film.
